inj.note: Mays has fully recovered from a fractured wrist that caused him to start the regular season on injured reserve. He should take over for Juice Scruggs as the Lions' starting center for Sunday's NFC North tilt.

news.h: Lions to get DB Brian Branch, C Cade Mays back vs. Packers
news.d: The Lions will have both Branch and center Cade Mays for Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers.
